│ said he had only wanted to see the lighthouse up close. Tomas nodded. He    │
│ did not tell him about the letter that would someday come, or that the      │
│ light had been built for exactly this, for people who did not know where    │
│ they were.                                                                  │
│                                                                             │
│ He only climbed the steps again, and counted.                               │
